scope: Mac E1M1 runs starting with empty route memory. All native positions and moving-object comparisons below are offline evaluation measurements. The player sees the game camera, its visible HUD and its own inputs.
pair_method: At up to 190 confirmed decision ticks per run, compared prior photos with similar coarse panoramas plus pairs assigned the same node in that run. Near means horizontal distance <=110 and vertical separation <=38 Quake units. Separate means horizontal distance >240 or vertical separation >80. Intermediate pairs excluded. Pairs within a run are correlated.

aim_check.units: pixel distance from center of aim after re-registering a stationary surface in independently rendered camera images

released_camera_holdout.method: After braking for 16 ticks, measure fixed-heading camera flow every four ticks for 24 ticks. Native rising/descending displacements above 12 units count as positive, five units or less as negative. The trial oversamples periods with moving level machinery.

native_ride_probes.scope: Native movement trials from snapshots in two previously observed runs, independent of campaign completion.
